text:
nate: quick heads up — p95 for paged-attn (L=1024) in prod jumped ~12% after the allocator rework merged. graph: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/pg-attn/p95?orgId=1 :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy rtx-alloc-refactor (commit abc123) rolled out to prod us-east — completed in 3m — rollout id: r-2026-03-17-09:12

elaine: ugh. did that change touch the blocktable handoff path?

nate: yes — we replaced slab-per-shard with a deferred handoff using a slotmap freelist (PR #1839). snippet from the change:```
kv_alloc->handoff = DEFERRED_SLOTMAP;
kv_alloc->compact_threshold = 0.15; // new default
```

sara: grabbed a flamegraph from a p95 trace. main diff is ~1.8ms extra in kv_page_lookup + higher page_fault handling. short numbers: before kv_page_lookup 0.7ms / page_faults 0.1ms, after kv_page_lookup 2.0ms / page_faults 0.4ms. full trace: https://perf.internal/trace/1950

mike: that pattern smells like fragmentation -> more page fetches + cache churn. slotmap handoff creates more small holes in the block table which increases pagehouse evictions.

elaine: can you paste the top allocation stack? also confirm batching heuristics weren't changed for this route in the same deploy.

nate: batching unchanged for the route. alloc stack from the trace:```
#0 kv_alloc_lookup
#1 blocktable_fetch_or_alloc
#2 paged_attn_fetch_kv
#3 attention_kernel_dispatch -> fused_flash_v2
```

sara: local microbench (1000 runs):
- p95 tokens/ms per request
  - master@before: 21.3ms
  - after-alloc-refactor: 24.0ms (+12.7%)
- memory: RSS variance +8%

mike: two mitigation ideas (quick):
1) fallback kernel: if blocktable_fragmentation > 0.25 switch to fused-attn-legacy (less allocation pressure)
2) background compaction worker that coalesces slotmap holes after N writes

elaine: could we avoid freelist churn by pre-allocating buckets on hot shards? a windowed bucket pool sized by seq_len distribution might cut page_faults.

nate: i can prototype runtime prealloc flag: `KV_SLOTMAP_PREALLOC=1` and toggle via config for canary.

dev-bot: telemetry note: added metric `kv.slotmap_frag_ratio` and `kv.pagehouse_evictions`; should appear in dashboards within ~5m.

sara: tested prealloc locally:
- toggle prealloc -> p95 21.8ms (almost baseline)
- compaction worker reduced RSS variance but introduces ~0.3ms periodic latency spikes when running

mike: classic tradeoff: compaction cost vs steady-state lookup cost. suggestion: prealloc + soft compaction during low QPS windows.

elaine: short-term options: revert allocator PR (safer but loses slotmap benefits) OR make new behavior opt-in via runtime flag defaulted off and enable prealloc for canary customers.

nate: action plan:
- don't revert for now; prefer runtime flag default off
- enable prealloc in us-east canary; watch `kv.slotmap_frag_ratio` and p95
- add kernel fallback when frag_ratio > 0.3
- land a microbench PR with p95 numbers for both kernels and prealloc config

sara: i'll own the canary dashboard and set alert thresholds (p95 > +8% or frag_ratio > 0.25)

mike: i'll sketch compaction worker PoC + perf harness this afternoon

elaine: i'll add the runtime flag, feature-gate it, and produce a rollout playbook for ops

nate: thanks team :thumbsup: i'll open a short RFC and link here when ready

nate: RFC draft: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2002

elaine reacted with :rocket:
